rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the reciter
verb expressing potential or habitual recitation
instrument expressing the manner of recitation
noun denoting benefit or highest good
verb indicating the arising of the result

items.question: What benefit results from constant recitation performed with devotion?
premises: A person may recite this text always.
The recitation is performed with devotion.
Welfare arises as the outcome of such recitation.
items.inference: Constant devotional recitation produces welfare for the reciter.
items.plain_english: O beloved, for one who always recites with devotion, welfare indeed arises.
